title: Hobbyist Roots
description: Started building small projects in Unreal Engine for fun — long before it was a job. In parallel, set a course toward a B.S. in Aerospace Engineering (Astronautics Option) at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University. Two disciplines, one habit: designing complex systems and making sure every part talks to the others correctly.

title: Marketplace Debut
description: Shipped two commercial assets within days of each other on the Unreal Engine Marketplace. Oct 7: the Interaction System — a Blueprint-first framework for doors, buttons, elevators, and pickups. Oct 11: the FPS Scope and Reticle Modular Creator — a modular toolkit for building custom scopes and weapon HUD overlays without per-scope custom code. First time strangers were paying for something built after class.

assets.title: FPS Scope and Reticle Modular Creator

title: Modular Building System Ships
description: A grid-snapped modular construction kit for single-player worlds — walls, roofs, railings, foundations.

title: Epic Games Sponsorship
description: The Interaction System was hand-picked by Epic Games for a "Sponsored Content Award and Featured" placement — the Marketplace's highest distinction — putting it in front of every developer browsing the store that month. It's the reason the units-shipped counter reads six figures.

title: Onto Fab
description: Epic's Marketplace became Fab. Shipped the Stylized Nature & Environment Biomes pack — seasonal foliage and scatter systems — as the first asset built for the new storefront.

title: Multiplayer, for Real
description: Shipped Building System | Multiplayer Ready — a fully replicated, networked building and placement system for survival and base-building games. The most technically ambitious asset yet.

title: Full-Time on Unreal Engine
description: Degree in hand, now going full-time into Unreal Engine development — running five live commercial assets, taking on contract work, and posting the tutorials that document how all of it gets built.
